description.en: The T-1 (3 mm) through-hole LED lamp class: a round epoxy body with a domed lens and a flange, and two leads 2.54 mm apart, the cathode the shorter. In a paper circuit its leads are bent flat onto copper-tape pads or pushed through the sheet; its body can stand in a round hole.
description.es: La clase de LED de inserción T-1 (3 mm): un cuerpo redondo de epoxi con lente abombada y pestaña, y dos patas a 2.54 mm entre sí, la del cátodo más corta. En un circuito de papel las patas se doblan sobre las pistas de cinta de cobre o atraviesan la hoja; el cuerpo puede asomar por un barreno redondo.
description.fr: La classe de LED traversante T-1 (3 mm) : un corps rond en époxy à lentille bombée et collerette, et deux pattes espacées de 2,54 mm, celle de la cathode plus courte. Dans un circuit papier, les pattes sont repliées sur les plages de ruban de cuivre ou traversent la feuille ; le corps peut passer par un trou rond.
description.pt: A classe de LED de inserção T-1 (3 mm): um corpo redondo de epóxi com lente abaulada e flange, e dois terminais a 2,54 mm um do outro, o do cátodo mais curto. Num circuito de papel os terminais dobram-se sobre as trilhas de fita de cobre ou atravessam a folha; o corpo pode passar por um furo redondo.

governing.designation: T-1 (3 mm) through-hole LED lamp, two leads on 2.54 mm (COTS class)

sources.title: Kingbright WP710A10ID, T-1 (3mm) solid state lamp, datasheet (Spec No DSAL0505, Rev V.12A, 08/11/2023)
sources.supports: T-1 (3 mm) package: lens Ø2.9; flange Ø3.2; 4.6 ±0.3 from the dome tip to the flange's underside; flange 1 thick; resin up to 1.0 max below the flange; leads 27 min, 0.5 square (+0.25/−0.1), 2.54 apart where they leave the package; the lead marked cathode is 1.5 ±1 shorter; recommended PCB layout two Ø0.9 holes 2.54 apart; general tolerance ±0.25

sources.title: Vishay TLDR4400, high intensity LED in Ø 3 mm tinted diffused package, datasheet (document 83001, Rev. 2.0, 14-Oct-14)
sources.supports: 3 mm (T-1) package: body Ø2.9 ±0.1; flange Ø3.2 ±0.15; 4.4 ±0.3 from the dome tip to the flange's underside and 3.4 ±0.15 to its top; resin < 0.6 below the flange; leads 0.5 (+0.2/−0.1) × 0.4 (+0.15/−0.05), 2.54 nom. apart; the two leads differ in length by 1.5 ±0.5; dome R1.4

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the flange's underside (the lead side), on the lamp's axis. +z runs up through the flange (top at z = 1) and the body to the dome tip; the leads leave at z < 0. +x runs from the cathode lead to the anode lead: by this frame's convention the cathode sits at x = −1.27 and the anode at x = +1.27 (half the cited 2.54 pitch, derived); +y completes a right-handed frame. The body is round, so the body interface has continuous symmetry; the leads do not.

body_diameter.note: Vishay TLDR4400; Kingbright WP710A10ID draws the same Ø2.9 lens (source 0)

flange_diameter.note: Vishay TLDR4400; Kingbright WP710A10ID draws the same Ø3.2 (source 0)

flange_thickness.note: Kingbright WP710A10ID; Vishay's 4.4 − 3.4 gives the same 1.0 (derived)

body_height_min.note: dome tip to the flange's underside, Vishay TLDR4400

body_height_max.note: dome tip to the flange's underside, Kingbright WP710A10ID

lead_pitch.note: where the leads leave the package (Kingbright); Vishay: 2.54 nom. (source 1)

lead_length_min.note: Kingbright: from the flange's underside to the end of the longer lead

cathode_lead_shortfall.note: Kingbright: the lead marked cathode is this much shorter; Vishay draws a 1.5 ±0.5 difference (source 1)

resin_below_flange_max.note: Kingbright: resin may stand this far below the flange's underside (Vishay: < 0.6, source 1); the seating plane is not flat

pcb_hole_diameter.note: Kingbright's recommended PCB layout: two holes 2.54 apart

interfaces.note: Male: the two leads go through holes or onto pads 2.54 apart. Symmetry 1: cathode and anode are not interchangeable; x_axis points from the cathode to the anode, so a partner framed the same way puts the anode pad (Pliego pin 'anode') on its +x side and the cathode pad (pin 'cathode') on its −x side.
Male: the body goes up through a round hole in a sheet or panel and the flange's top face (z = 1) bears on the hole's back face. The normal points along the body toward the hole.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (K3 lane, 2026-10-10); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: only the shared package facts are stated (body Ø, flange thickness, lead pitch and lead width, flange Ø); body height and lead lengths are the cited members' and vary across the class. Colour, forward voltage and current ratings depend on the die and are not facts of this entry: read them from the chosen lamp's datasheet. Pliego §5.30 names this part's pads with pin 'anode' and 'cathode'.

solids.note: the body as a cylinder to the dome tip (bounds the dome)

envelope.note: Flange and body at the larger cited member's height; tolerances are not added. The leads are left out (they are cut or bent to suit), and so is the resin that may stand below the flange.
